functions.note: OPEN, exact size (696 B), three causes: (1) a saved-register rotation s3/s4/s5 between x, w and isbg; (2) `move a2,a1` vs the SDK `move a2,zero` (the FntLoad trait); (3) two indexed loads `lw rd,sym+off(rs)`: the SDK (ASPSX) uses the DESTINATION register as the address temp, stock maspsx/gas use $at. PSYZ FONT_TILE re-index spelling is REQUIRED (without it: 160 words, 724 B).
